purpose: Single source of truth for navigation. Implement every control below exactly. Control labels match the visible text or the accessible name; the prototype matches by prefix.
history: Back and BACK mean: return to the previous screen in the history stack.

special_destinations.BACK: Return to the previous screen in the navigation history.
special_destinations.FROM: Setup finished or skipped. If the previous screen is 39 (My items), return to 39. Otherwise go to 22 (Home).
special_destinations.MULTI: Go to 52 if several categories are chosen (the prototype uses: More categories was opened). Otherwise go to 36.
special_destinations.ADD: Start the add-debt flow (flow=add_debt) and go to 17.
special_destinations.ADDP: Start the add-debt-for-a-person flow (flow=add_debt_person) and go to 53.
special_destinations.NEXT17: If flow=add_debt go to 53. Otherwise (a sale on credit) go to 18.
special_destinations.NEXT53: Apply the inheritance rule: if the person has no balance, or no due date and no plan, go to 18. Otherwise go to 31 and show the inherited terms. (The prototype uses flow=add_debt_person to decide; the brief's inheritance rule is the real rule.)
special_destinations.MOMO: Start a MoMo payment from the current screen. Remember the origin screen. Always go to 61 (never block the sale on setup).
special_destinations.MOMO16: Done on 16, in this order: (1) parts must sum to the total; (2) if a MoMo part exists, confirm it (Direct: 62; Phone request: 56 then 57, setup via 60 if needed); (3) commit once; (4) go to 30. If the request fails go to 59 and keep the draft on 16. Same order, lock and leave question (decided 11 Nov 2026) on the collect split 27 (also when opened from 19) and on 19's own MoMo choice: Direct on 61 returns unconfirmed; 62 opens only at Received (27) or Save plan (19); money confirmed on 62 is locked if the save then fails; leaving a draft that holds received MoMo asks the leave question. Back from 16 opened from 55 keeps the parts the same way as from 15. Leave on Back with received MoMo goes: from 16 to an empty 15, from 27 to Home, from 19 to an empty 15 (Home for a manual debt). While 19 holds received MoMo, Next cycle is disabled (choosing it would drop the money) and the payment-recorded panel shows "Received" with a green check or "not confirmed yet" under each part.
special_destinations.MOMO27: Received on 27: if a MoMo part exists, run the MoMo request for that part (56) before recording the collection. Otherwise go to 28.
special_destinations.SEND: Send the request to Paystack. If the charge asks for a code (status send_otp), go to 58. Otherwise go to 57. (The prototype goes to 58 only when Telecel is chosen.)
special_destinations.MOMOOK: From 62: the merchant confirms the money arrived (recorded 'MoMo · you confirmed'). From the Paystack flow: charge confirmed (recorded 'MoMo · verified'). Go to 30 for a sale (15, 55, 16) or 28 for a collection (25, 26, 27). From 19: continue the plan commit (31, or 16 in flow=split).
special_destinations.PAYOTHER: Return to the origin screen so the merchant can choose another payment method.
special_destinations.CANCELMOMO: Cancel the pending request and return to the origin screen.
special_destinations.SAVEMOMO: Save the payout account and create or update the Paystack subaccount. If the merchant arrived by tapping MoMo, continue to 56. Otherwise return to the previous screen.
special_destinations.DIRECT: From 61: go to 62. Needs no setup beyond the merchant's own MoMo number. Records the MoMo part as 'you confirmed'.
special_destinations.PHONE: From 61: if the Paystack payout account is not set up go to 60 (Save and verify continues to 56); otherwise go to 56.
special_destinations.MOMOPICK: MoMo tile on 16 (split): first ask how much (amount editor prefilled with Left to pay, can be lowered), then go to 61 with pick16 set and that amount. DIRECT or PHONE then records the method on the MoMo part and returns to 16. With a direct MoMo row already present, the tile raises it and only the extra goes to 61/62. Nothing is requested yet.
special_destinations.SAVECREDIT: Save on 18 or 19. If flow=split, mark the Owe part complete and return to 16 (drop the screens in between from history). Otherwise go to 31. Signature step (decided 16 Nov 2026): the credit is saved first, then 72 opens when the amount of THAT credit event (the Owe part for a sale, the amount added for a manual debt; older balance is not counted) is at or above VITE_SIGNATURE_THRESHOLD_PESEWAS, then continue through SIGNED. Applies to sale on credit, plan on 19 (sale), Add debt 53 (also the inherited-terms save) and the split sale. Below the threshold there is no signature step. flow=split: nothing is saved on 18/19 (they only return to 16); the credit is saved on Done on 16, then 72 opens, then continue to 30 or 31 as before.
special_destinations.SAVE19: Same as SAVECREDIT (including the signature step after the save).
special_destinations.MOMOPICK19: MoMo on 19: go to 61 with pick19 set. The chosen method returns to 19.
special_destinations.SIGNED: Done, Skip for now or Back on 72. Continue to where the save would have gone: 31 for a sale on credit or add debt, 30 or 31 after a split sale, ManualDebtSaved for a manual debt. 72 after a save starts a fresh history stack (like the result screens), and both the on-screen Back and the phone back act as Skip for now. When 72 was opened by Get signature on 29 or 43, Done, Skip for now and Back return to that screen (29 or 43).

flows_and_flags.flow=add_debt: Set by Add debt on 32. Hides the Owed banner on 17. Cleared on arriving at 22 or 15.
flows_and_flags.flow=add_debt_person: Set by + Add to debt on 29 or 43. Cleared on arriving at 22 or 15.
flows_and_flags.flags: estimatedProfit and trackCost (Settings, screen 47). Both off by default. If both are on, the cost-price version of 33 wins. trackCost shows the Cost price field on 40 and 41.
flows_and_flags.momo: Origin screen is remembered (momoFrom). momoReady no longer gates the first MoMo tap: 61 always opens, and only 'Phone request' needs 60. Setting 'When I tap MoMo' (63) can skip 61: Ask me each time (default), Always customer sends, Always phone request.
flows_and_flags.flow=split: Set by Owe on 16. Draft sale holds all parts. Cleared on arriving at 22, 15 or 30.

states.29/43: One DebtorDetail component. 43 is the late state, 29 the on-time state.
states.33/48/49: One MyMoney component: default, estimated profit, profit from item costs.
states.40/50: One EditItem component: with or without cost price.
states.36/52: One YourStarterList component: single list, or grouped when the combined core list exceeds about 30 items.
states.69/70: PlanPaymentResult: 69 paid and confirmed (Paystack), 70 waiting to confirm (cash or direct MoMo, a StoreKeeper agent or admin confirms).
states.16: SplitPayment draft: one row per mode (Cash, MoMo, Owe). Owe always equals Left to pay. Row status shows MoMo method and Owe person and terms.

rules: Draft survives a trip away (bug found 11 Nov 2026): the amount typed on the keypad, the payment choice (Cash or MoMo) and any items added are kept when the owner goes to a screen opened from 15 (Add items, Owe and its steps, Split payment, MoMo and its steps, Menu > Settings) and comes back with Back or the phone's back button. 15 must show the same amount, not 0.00. The draft is cleared only after a sale is saved (Done), or when the owner taps the header Home or a different bottom-bar tab (Home, Owed). Like the split screen, 15 keeps its draft in the route parameters. After a MoMo pick returns, the pending MoMo values are removed so an old amount can never come back.

Done on 15 (final, 17 Nov 2026): Done is NOT pinned. It is the 60px solid green button at the end of the content, with bottom space so that it ends fully above the fixed bottom bar (the raised Sell button) when you scroll to the end. On 15 the keypad keys are 54px high (62px elsewhere, key spacing unchanged). With these sizes Done is fully visible without scrolling from about 740px of screen height up (360x740, 393x800, 393x852); on shorter screens (340x640, 340x667, 360x667) the screen scrolls about 40 to 65px and Done is reached at the end of the scroll. Accepted: the amount card, the spacing between blocks and the "+ Add items" row are not changed to win more room. Nothing on 15 is covered by a floating element. "+ Add items" is the add look, compact 44px on this screen only.

Keyboard (decided 23 Nov 2026, all widths, behaviour fix): a focused keypad key counts as no focus, so digits, '.' and ',' keep going to the pad after a mouse click and Enter means Done (when Done is enabled) instead of pressing that key again. The Delete key does the same as Backspace. Any other focused button (for example a payment tile) keeps its normal Enter and Space behaviour, and keys typed in a text field are never taken by the pad. Escape closes a dialog.

Last sale box wording (decided 23 Nov 2026): amount is the sale total (formatGhs), time through formatTime. Method: Cash, MoMo or Split when nothing is owed; 'On credit' when the whole sale was put on credit; 'Part paid' when some money was received and some is owed. Read-only indexed query on today's sale types (sale, installment_sale, installment_addon), newest first, run after Sell has drawn.

COST IS PRIVATE (decided 24 Nov 2026): when a sale is saved, each item line copies the item's cost into cost_at_sale_pesewas (null when none). No cost figure ever appears on Sell, receipts, the WhatsApp receipt or any customer-facing text. Changing the price of a line does not change its cost snapshot.

rules: A MoMo row whose money has been received is locked (decided 11 Nov 2026): when the phone request is verified, or the owner has tapped "Money received" on 62 for a Direct MoMo, the row cannot be edited or removed. It shows no pencil and no x, the amount in a plain (non-chip) style, and the status line "Received" with a green check. Before the money is confirmed a Direct MoMo row can be edited or removed, and its status line reads "Customer sends to my number · not confirmed yet". If a later step fails and the draft returns to 16, the locked rows stay locked. Cash is never locked. If a locked MoMo row exists and the owner leaves the draft (Cancel sale on 59, header Home, or another tab), ask first: "GH₵{amount} MoMo was already received and will not be recorded. Leave anyway?" with Stay (default) and Leave. Back from 16 (the on-screen Back and the phone back button) behaves like leaving the draft when a locked MoMo row exists: it asks the same question and only goes to 15 if the owner chooses Leave, in which case the whole draft, including the split parts, is discarded. Never go back to 15 with received money still held in a hidden draft. With no locked row, Back goes to 15 and keeps the split parts in 15's route parameters, so tapping Split payment again reopens 16 with the same Cash, MoMo and Owe parts; if the amount on 15 was changed meanwhile (the total no longer matches the parts) the parts are cleared and 16 starts again with the new total. The draft is cleared as before by Done, header Home or another tab. A Direct MoMo pick is NOT confirmed when it is chosen: it returns to 16 as "not confirmed yet" and is confirmed on 62 only after Done, as in MOMO16.

Where Done ends (decided 11 Nov 2026): after the sale is saved, if any money was received today (a Cash or MoMo part above zero) go to 30 Sale recorded, which lists each paid part and a line "{Name} still owes GH₵x" for the owed part. If nothing was received today (the whole sale is owed, so the only part is Owe) go to 31 Saved as credit, the same as a plain credit sale from 15. Screen 30 must never refuse a saved sale: if its receipt cannot be built it shows "Sale saved." with a Done button that goes Home.
The draft survives Menu > Settings > Back; header Home discards it.

Editable amounts must look editable (11 Nov 2026): on every row of the draft that can be changed (Cash and MoMo only) the amount is shown as a tappable chip: light grey background, grey 2px border, the amount in bold 21px and a small green pencil icon on its right, at least 48px tall, with the accessible name "Edit {Cash|MoMo} amount". The Owe row (decided 11 Nov 2026) shows the same chip look without a pencil and is not tappable, because the Owe amount always equals Left to pay and carries the customer and plan terms set on 18 and 19; to change it the owner removes it with x and adds Owe again. Tapping the chip (or the row) opens the same editor as today. The remove button (x) stays separate at the far right. Under "Sale total" one quiet line: "Tap an amount to change it." A row that cannot be edited shows no pencil. At 360px the chip must not clip GH₵12,345.00 or push the remove button out of the row.

Row layout on 16 and 27 (decided 12 Nov 2026), the same at every width (360px, 393px and wider): line 1 = icon, short name (Cash, MoMo, Owe), the amount chip and the x; line 2 = the status text using the full card width (at most 2 lines). Never put the status text in a narrow column beside the chip. Status rows (decided 17 Nov 2026, replaces the one-line status wording): under the chip row, small label-value rows in the same style as 72 (grey label left, bold value right, thin dividers, 16px, shared row component, labels short per rules_global.kv_labels). MoMo not confirmed: "Status" / "Not confirmed yet"; MoMo confirmed: "Status" / "Received ✓". Owe with an installment plan: "Person" / {Name}, "Payment" / "GH₵{amount} weekly | Every 2 weeks | monthly" (the amount is the payment each time, never a bare amount that looks like the Owe chip), "First payment" / dd/mm/yyyy. Owe with a due date and no plan: "Person" / {Name}, "Due" / dd/mm/yyyy. Owe due today or with no date: "Person" / {Name} only. Cash has no rows. Never put the status text in a narrow column beside the chip.

Left to pay row (decided 23 Nov 2026, from the owner's phone test): the 'Left to pay' row is shown only while the amount left is above zero. When the parts add up to the sale total (Left to pay would read GH₵0.00, which is always the case once an Owe row exists, because Owe equals what was left) the row is not shown at all, and Done is the signal that nothing is left. It reappears at once if a part is changed or removed so that something is left. Same on 16 and 27, phone and wide.

Owe in the draft panel (decided 12 Nov 2026): the rows above "Total today" must add up to it, so Owe is never listed among the payment rows. Below the total, a separate pink row with a person icon shows the unpaid part: "Still owed · {Name}" with the amount on the right. It is not part of the total. If nothing is owed the pink row is not shown. The same rule applies to any panel with a total line on 27, 28, 30 and 31: a total always equals the sum of the rows above it.

Draft survives Back (decided 12 Nov 2026, reported on the phone): in the sale-on-credit flow (15 → 17 → 34/18 → 19 → 27) everything the owner has typed or chosen is kept when they go Back and return, until the sale is saved (Done or Save plan) or the owner leaves with header Home or another tab. Nothing is lost by going one step back and forward. Kept values live in the route parameters, like 15 and 16. On 19 that means How much each time, How often, First payment (Today or Next cycle), Amount paid today, Next payment date and the chosen method or split parts. Opening Split payment (27) from 19 and coming back with Back keeps the 19 values; opening 27 again reopens it with the same Cash and MoMo parts.

Still owed row, all flows (clarified 12 Nov 2026 after a phone test): the pink "Still owed · {Name}" row under "Total today" is shown whenever the Paying today panel is shown and something remains owed after today's payment, in every flow, not only when an Owe part sits in a split draft. Amount = the Owed figure at the top of 19 minus the amount paid today (the customer's balance after this sale and today's payment, the same figure screen 31 shows as "owes"). Example: sale GH₵8.00 on credit, GH₵2.00 paid today (Cash 1.00 + MoMo 1.00) shows the rows Cash 1.00, MoMo 1.00, Total today GH₵2.00, then the pink row "Still owed · Kofi Mensah GH₵6.00". If today's payment settles the whole balance, the pink row is absent.

Paying today panel with one method (decided 12 Nov 2026): the panel is shown whenever Amount paid today is above zero and a method is chosen, also for Cash only or MoMo only (one row, then Total today, then the pink Still owed row). Paying today alignment (decided 16 Nov 2026, found on a real phone): in the panel every amount shares one right edge: Cash, MoMo, Total today and the Still owed row. Total today and its amount use the same inner padding as the Cash and MoMo rows, so GH₵6.00 ends exactly under GH₵4.00 and GH₵2.00. Equal-width digits (tabular-nums). A render test measures the right edges of the amounts at 340, 360 and 393px.
Paid today with Start today (decided 16 Nov 2026): the amount must be above 0. Paying nothing today is what Next cycle is for, so 0 stays refused with "Enter the amount being paid today."

Soft tiles on phone 19 (decided 24 Nov 2026, same as wide D10): the Owed block at the top, the Paying today panel and the Still owed row use #F1F5F9, no pink or mint fill and no coloured border; amounts neutral #0F172A; white rows inside with #E2E8F0 dividers. Shown with an "Estimate" tag, the line "Sales 300.00 − stock 150.00 − other costs 30.00", and "Average of last 4 weeks" only when there are at least 4 weeks of data. Item-level profit (version B, "Based on 8 of 10 items" and Add costs) stays deferred until items have cost prices.
The comparison with last week uses integer pesewas through the shared formatter. A value that cannot be real (for example more than a million cedis) must be checked as a possible unit bug.
Built and kept: no Open Settings or Add costs controls on 33. The profit card is hidden with the one switch in Settings (47); there is no nudge card.

One bad or inconsistent record must never stop the screen loading. A record whose parts do not add up (for example a credit sale whose cash and credit parts do not match the sale amount) is left out of the totals, logged with its id to the console, and the screen shows one quiet line: "1 sale is not counted because its amounts do not match." (plural: "{n} sales are not counted..."). The same must hold on every screen that sums money (22 and others), not only 33.

Money in by method: cash and MoMo parts of sales (split sales count each part once) plus debt payments collected, by the method they were paid with. Credit parts are not money received and never count as cash or MoMo. Balance corrections are not money and never count. Total = Cash + MoMo and equals the green block's money in.

Money spent by method: every expense records how it was paid (Cash or MoMo). Spending recorded before this existed has no method: show a row "Method not recorded" only when above zero; Paid in cash + Paid by MoMo + Method not recorded = Money spent.

Where your money should be: Cash = cash in minus cash spent; MoMo = MoMo in minus MoMo spent, for the selected period only. It does not include money held before the period. Caption: "This period only. Check your MoMo balance." The two figures plus any unrecorded spending explain the green block. "On credit" is shown once, as the last row inside Money in, with the same figure as the "Given on credit" tile on 24 (the owed part of sales plus Added to debt for the period), so the two screens never differ. rules_global.currency: Show money as GH₵ followed directly by the amount, for example GH₵268.20. Use the app's existing money formatter everywhere. The letters GHS appear only as the currency parameter of API calls. rules_global.date_format: All dates are shown as dd/mm/yyyy (for example 14/11/2026) through one shared formatter. The prototype month-name dates (2 Oct, 19 Dec) are examples only. Browser date inputs show the device format.
rules_global.amount_entry: Typed amounts are parsed to integer pesewas by integer math from the typed text, never through floating point. Exponent and hex text (1e2, 0x10) are refused. Pasted text with more than two decimals: a third digit of 5 or more rounds the pesewa up. Typing a third decimal digit is not accepted (4.00 then 2 does not become 4.002). One shared amount keypad (decided 15 Nov 2026) on Sell 15, Add debt 53, Collect 25, Split 26/27 and any other pad: keys 1 to 9, then a last row of four equal keys ". 0 00 delete" (delete in the same grey style). Digits fill whole cedis from the left: 8 gives GH₵8.00 and 85 gives GH₵85.00; "." starts pesewas with at most two decimals; a second "." is ignored; "00" is ignored on an empty pad and after "."; leading zeros are not shown. Spent money 44 keeps a typed field with the phone number keyboard (decimal key) and follows the same rules. A scan fails if a second keypad implementation exists. Typed amount fields (split field on 16/27, 19 each time and paid today, 44, 45, 46, balance correction): when a field with an amount gets focus the whole amount is selected, so the first digit typed replaces it; at most two decimals while typing; one "."; digits only. The text is always right-aligned with the GH₵ label on the left. Zero in a typed field (decided 16 Nov 2026): a lone 0 stays visible as 0 in every typed amount field (typing 0 never makes the field look empty); a leading zero before another digit is dropped (05 becomes 5); 0.5 and 0.00 are kept. This is separate from the keypad, which keeps its own rule. Each screen then applies its own validation to the value 0 (for example 54 accepts it, an expense or a supplier payment still needs an amount above zero).

rules_global.connection_status: Online and offline status (decided 14 Nov 2026): the app always shows whether the device is online. Online = a bright green dot (#22C55E with a soft green ring). (3) 'Collect first' on Home: up to two people with the largest late balances, most late first (same order as the phone tile), each with its due tag, amount and Collect, WhatsApp and Call (Call only with a valid number); hidden when nobody owes. (4) Person column in Today's transactions: the customer's name in Title Case (displayName), a dash when there is none. The wide-layout test must assert that each addition reads from the same source as the phone and changes no stored value. Wide D3 (Owed detail pane): the same 'Last reminder' line sits between the Collect/Reminder/Call row and the Edit contact/Correct balance row; the 7-day sheet opens as a dialog.
wide_layout.layout_mode_function:
One function decides the mode from the width alone: below 768 phone, 768 to 1279 rail, 1280 and up sidebar. Touch and orientation are not inputs. Width is read in one place (one hook) and the mode is passed down. Page layouts use the mode, not lg: classes, for Home and My money (My money keeps the phone layout below 1024px); other screens keep their lg: classes until their own wide step.
Sidebar tap: pushes the destination like the Menu drawer so the draft stays in history and Back returns to it; Home follows the header Home rule (leaves the draft, with the MoMo leave question); choosing the page already showing does nothing.
wide_layout.rail_padding: Rail only (768 to 1279px): wide page side padding is 20px instead of 32px, and Home's Today's transactions card side padding is 12px instead of 20px, so the five-column table fits at 768px with five-digit amounts. 1280px and up keep 32px and 20px. Phone unchanged.
wide_layout.spent_row_look: Superseded 22 Nov 2026: Home uses the same table as 24 (see the Home and 24 wide entries). Balance corrected and Stock on credit rows move no money: their amount is shown in words under the title and their money cells show dashes.
wide_layout.design_principles: Decided 22 Nov 2026 after reviewing the first wide Home and My money. (1) Never stretch a phone component to the page width: buttons have a maximum width (about 160 to 240px), a person or list row is one compact line (name and tag, amount, then the buttons together at the right), and a row never leaves more than about 24px between a name and its amount except in a table. (2) One hero number per screen (about 56px, bold 700); every other amount is 36 to 40px at most, neutral dark #0F172A, app font weight 700, never extra-bold and never another font. Meaning comes from the label, the tag and the thin category edge, not from colouring a big number. (3) One saturated colour block per screen (the hero) and one primary action; every other button follows the button system (other = outlined dark). (4) Body text and labels are 17px or larger; tags, badges and small helper lines under a field or button are 15px or larger (clarified 23 Nov 2026: no text is 16px or smaller than 15px). On task screens the shared TaskColumn sets the base size to 17px so text without its own size class inherits it. (5) Cards in a row have equal height and the same padding on an 8px grid. (6) Touch targets 48px or taller, and a whole tile is the target, not a small link inside it. A wide build is reviewed against this list before it is called ready.

rules_global.menu_drawer: The menu is a left drawer over the current page, never a separate page. Header Menu button at the left (see 23). It adds no history entry and keeps drafts. Back from a destination chosen in the drawer returns to the page the drawer was opened from.
rules_global.header_always_visible: The header (Menu button or home tile, shop name, connection status) is fixed at the top of the screen on every screen and at every width while the content scrolls beneath it (decided 14 Nov 2026 from a phone test where the Menu button was out of sight on a long Home). It keeps the safe-area inset and the 3px bottom border, sits above content and below the Menu drawer and dialogs, and is never hidden or moved by scrolling or by the virtual keyboard. There is no hide-on-scroll behaviour.
rules_global.times_24h: Every time of day is written HH:mm in 24-hour form by a hand-built formatter, never by the device locale, like dates are written dd/mm/yyyy (decided 14 Nov 2026 after a locale-dependent receipt time was found).

reminders.status: Design approved 15 Nov 2026. Build after the merge.
reminders.data: A new local 'reminder sent' event: person, time, channel. Stored on the device, included in backup and restore. Appended only, never edited.
reminders.scope: Per person, not per screen. Every reminder button (Home Collect first tile 22, Owed list rows 32, debtor detail 29/43 and wide D3) goes through ONE shared check and ONE shared record. Receipts do not count. The Last reminder line is shown only on debtor detail 29/43 and the wide detail pane D3; the Home tile and Owed rows stay clean.
reminders.check: Within 7 days of the last reminder the Send another reminder? sheet appears; Send again is the strong button.

rules_global.form_errors: Errors on every form (decided 16 Nov 2026): a message appears only after the owner taps the main button with a problem, names only what is wrong, and disappears as soon as that problem is fixed (no second tap needed). A fresh or returning form never shows an error. One shared behaviour; a test per form that has an error box.

customer_proof.why: A merchant could add credit without the customer knowing, and a customer could deny real credit. A tap-only I agree can be tapped by the merchant, so the customer signs with a finger instead.
customer_proof.show_the_customer: 29 and 43 have Show {Name} the record, a read-only screen 73 the customer can read.
customer_proof.signature: Credits of GH₵50.00 or more open 72 after saving. Skip for now always allowed; the credit is never blocked. Unsigned credits are tagged Not signed and can be signed later with Get signature.
customer_proof.threshold: VITE_SIGNATURE_THRESHOLD_PESEWAS, default 5000, read only in src/config/features.js.
customer_proof.what_for: Every credit shows its reason on 29, 43 and 73.
customer_proof.stored: signature (vector strokes) and signedAt live on the debt event, local, in backup and restore. Dexie version bump only if a new table is needed; prefer fields on the existing event.
customer_proof.deferred: Customer confirmation by link on WhatsApp with a server timestamp waits for the backend. Codes generated on the phone are NOT used: they prove nothing and conflict with MoMo anti-fraud advice.
customer_proof.corrections: Balance corrections after a signature stay visible on 73 (Balance corrected, old → new, reason), so a signed amount cannot be quietly changed.
customer_proof.fields: On the transactions row of the credit event: signature, signedAt, signedAmountPesewas, signedReason. No Dexie version bump.
customer_proof.limits: Points are whole numbers 0..1000, at most 1,500 points (about 18 KB as JSON), thinned on Done if longer. A signature is written once and never replaced.
customer_proof.sync: Signature fields are stripped from any sync payload, and signing does not mark the event pending. The signature stays on this phone and in backup files.
customer_proof.no_reason: A keypad sale with no items, or a generated word like Sale or Other amount, counts as no reason: show "No reason written".
customer_proof.threshold_scope: The threshold applies to each credit event on its own. Signature row (decided 17 Nov 2026, replaces "anything not signed shows Not signed"): the Signature row, the Signed / Not signed tag and "Get signature" appear on 29, 43 and 73 only for a credit event that is signed, or whose amount is at or above the signature threshold. A credit below the threshold that was never signed shows no Signature row at all (its card has only Time and Reason). A signed event always shows "Signed ✓", even if the threshold was raised later.
customer_proof.paid_order: Wherever a payment is split, list Cash first, then MoMo, on 29, 43 and 73. One shared helper.

hide_amounts.why: The merchant often hands the phone to a customer. Profit and totals should not be readable by accident.
hide_amounts.where: Eye button on Home (22) and My money (33). One shared setting: hiding on one hides on both.
hide_amounts.hidden: Home and My money figures only: sales, profit, money in/out, what you should have left, owed to you, you owe suppliers. Always replaced by "GH₵ ••••" (fixed width). Extended 22 Nov 2026 (privacy at the counter): while Hide amounts is on, Home also hides every customer amount a bystander could read: the amount of each person in Collect first (phone and wide) and, on wide Home, the amounts in Today's transactions (Money in, Spent, On credit, and the amounts in the "Lowered by" and "You owe" lines). Names, tags and buttons stay. A masked amount's accessible name is "Amount hidden" and never contains the number.
hide_amounts.not_hidden: Amounts the owner is working with: the Sell keypad, Review and pay, Collect, debtor pages, Transactions, receipts, and the customer record 73. Those are about one sale or one person, not the shop's overall figures. On Home the Collect first row (one person's amount, with Collect, WhatsApp and Call) stays visible: it is the owner's working row. The Owed to you total above it is hidden.
hide_amounts.default: Amounts shown. The choice is remembered on this phone (local setting, in backup and restore as a setting) and survives restarting the app.
hide_amounts.accessibility: Button 48px, accessible name "Hide amounts" or "Show amounts" with the current state, icon eye / eye-off, never colour alone.
hide_amounts.shared_component: One AmountVisibility setting and one HiddenAmount rendering used by every hidden figure, so no figure can forget it (a test scans 22 and 33).

rules_global.no_text_chevrons: No chevron characters (›, >, ») anywhere in the app text, labels, i18n strings or tests (decided 16 Nov 2026). The Back arrow is a drawn icon; other buttons and links are written as words only (for example "See all", "Show {Name} the record", "Next"). A scan test fails if any chevron character appears in src/pos. The arrow → between two amounts (GH₵old → GH₵new) is not a chevron and stays.

button_system.other: Outlined, 2px dark (#0F172A) border, dark bold text, white fill: Back, Clear, Cancel, Show {Name} the record, Correct balance.

button_system.leave: Grey outline (2px #64748B border, #334155 bold text, white fill): leave without doing it (Skip for now, Not now). Lower priority than the main action but a real button.

Any other tappable text found by the sweep is added to this list with its look. Added after the first report (17 Nov 2026): "Add phone for a receipt" (28) = add, label "+ Add phone"; "Show all {count} suppliers" (45) = other; "Set up" (63) = other, on its own line under the card text; in a split row (16, 27) the method name is not tappable (the pencil chip is the one way to edit); "Not now" (reminder sheet) = leave; "Cancel sale" (59) = other; "+ New person" (17) and "+ New item" (39) = add; "Correct balance" and "Correct this entry" = other. Left as they are: Remind on WhatsApp, Edit contact, the Collect / WhatsApp / Call tiles, the Split buttons (listed as a later decision). "Today’s transactions" exists on Home (22) only. "+ New item" and "+ Add from starter list" on 39 are both the add look (39 has no solid green button; accepted).

A label that would reach a third line is fixed by padding, never by a shorter label; report such cases.
add_variants: The add look also has a radio variant (role="radio") for choices inside a list, used by "+ New supplier" on 45: same dashed border, corners, height and text as AddButton, one component.

Split payment tiles keep their icon (decided 20 Nov 2026, found on the phone: the add-look sweep replaced the icon with a "+"). Wherever Split payment is a payment tile or button (15, 55, 16, 19, 25 and its Collect sheet on Home, 26, 27) it shows its icon above or beside the label "Split payment", never a "+": cash + phone + person where Owe can be part of the split (15, 55, 16), cash + phone where only Cash and MoMo are possible (19, 25, 26, 27), as rules_global.wide_layout.icons says (a label is never shown without its icon). The look stays the add look (dashed 2px dark-green border) where it is already add; the tile is the same size as the Cash and MoMo tiles beside it. The icon is the joined icons as before (cash + MoMo + owe, or cash + MoMo, with the small plus signs between the icons, which stay); only the separate "+" symbol that the add look put in front of the label is removed. The separate "+" is only for add buttons that have no icon.

Split payment look everywhere (decided 21 Nov 2026, replaces the earlier "other look on 15 and 55"): every Split payment control on every screen (15, 55, 19, 25 and its Collect sheet on Home, 26, and the wide layouts) uses the add look: dashed 2px dark-green border, the joined icons, the same height and width rules as the tiles beside it. The label is "Split payment" where it fits on one line and "Split" on the four-tile rows of 15 and 55. Where it is a choice with a selected state (19), the selected state adds the green fill and tick like the other tiles, still dashed. Disabled keeps the dashed shape, faded.

credit_reason.why: A keypad sale or a split on credit had no place to say what the credit was for; only sales with items and Add debt had one. Customer proof needs a reason on every credit.
credit_reason.where: Screen 18 for every credit path (see the 18 rules).
credit_reason.stored: On the credit event (the transactions row): items_json and itemDescription for items, note for typed text. Report first how the existing fields hold it.
credit_reason.chips: Up to three recent distinct reasons from the last 30 days, tap to fill. Hidden when none.

rules_global.shell_height: Page shell (decided 16 Nov 2026): the area under the header must not use a hard-coded header height (it was 64px while the real header is 75px, so every screen scrolled by 11px at 360x667). Build the shell as a column of exactly the visible screen height (100dvh): header flex-none, page area flex-1 with min-height 0, so it adapts to any header height. A screen that fits must not scroll the page; a screen that does not fit scrolls inside the page area only, with Back and Save pinned.
rules_global.kv_labels: Key-value labels are short (decided 17 Nov 2026): at most about 14 characters and always one line at 340px. Put the detail in the value or in the title, never in a long label. Examples: "Paid", "Still needed", "Payments left", "Next payment", "Last reminder", "Paid with". The period words (this week, in these 2 weeks, this month) are not part of the labels. Payment frequency words (decided 17 Nov 2026): "weekly", "Every 2 weeks", "monthly" after the amount, for example "GH₵2.00 weekly" (from the translation file), instead of "every week".
rules_global.person_row: Person row (decided 17 Nov 2026, corrected 18 Nov 2026). Home 22 "Collect first" is the REFERENCE and must stay exactly as built today: name left, amount right (one line), due tag, then the buttons row: a labelled green "Collect" button, and the contact buttons beside it, which are the icon-only WhatsApp and Call buttons when the person has a phone number saved, or "+ Add contact" (add look) when there is none. Nothing about Home’s look, buttons or tap behaviour changes in the key-value work. Tap-through (existing behaviour, must be kept): tapping inside the person card on Home opens that person’s detail screen (43 when the debt is late, 29 otherwise). The tap area stays exactly what it is today or gets bigger, never smaller: Claude Code first tests and reports exactly which parts of the card open the detail today, and keeps all of them. Collect, WhatsApp, Call and Add contact keep their own targets and never open the detail. Accessible name "Open {Name}’s details", visible pressed state, not a text link (rules_global.button_system.no_link_buttons stays true). Back from 29 or 43 returns to the screen it came from (22 or 32). The Owed list 32 uses the same row component as Home: the same layout, buttons and tap-through, so 32 only changes where it differs from Home today (name, amount under the name, icon-only cash and person-with-pen buttons). On 32 the buttons row becomes Home’s: Collect (main) plus WhatsApp and Call icon buttons when a phone number exists, or "+ Add contact" when there is none. The pink card, the list and the other screens are unchanged. Saved number that fails the WhatsApp check (decided 21 Nov 2026): the WhatsApp and Call buttons show whenever ANY phone number is saved; WhatsApp then opens the share sheet through the shared opener (rules_global.whatsapp_links). "+ Add contact" shows only when no number is saved at all. Long names (decided 21 Nov 2026): the name is cut at two lines with an ellipsis, on Home 22 and the Owed list 32, never breaking inside a word where avoidable; the amount stays whole on the first line at the right and is never pushed; the tap area is unchanged. The full name is on the detail screen. Due tag on one line (decided 21 Nov 2026): the top row of PartyCard is a two-column grid: the name at the top left, the amount on the right across both rows, the due tag in a second row across the full width on one line, left-aligned under the name. It applies to Home 22, the Owed list 32 and the suppliers card 46 (shared component). Rows without a tag, and tags that already fit, stay in the same place; the tap area is unchanged.
rules_global.phone_search: Phone search (decided 18 Nov 2026), for every search field that accepts a phone number ("Search by name or phone" on 17 and 32, and any other that finds people by phone): people type a Ghana number the way they think of it, starting with 0 (024 123 4567), or without the 0 (24 123 4567), or in the international form (+233 24 123 4567, 233 24 123 4567, 00233 24 123 4567). All of these find the same person. Method: one shared function turns both the typed text and each stored number into digits only (spaces, dashes, dots, brackets and "+" removed), then removes a leading 00233 or 233, then removes one leading 0, leaving the national number (for example 241234567). A person matches when the typed national number is contained in theirs (typing the first digits, the last digits or the middle all work). If the typed text has at least one letter it is a name search (case ignored, spaces ignored as today); if it has only digits and phone characters it is a phone search; a person also matches a digits-only text when their name contains it. Typing only "0", "+", "233", "00233" or spaces (nothing left after cleaning) does not hide anyone: the list stays as it is until a digit after the 0 is typed. Works with the All, Late and Due soon filters, offline, never changes data. A person with no phone number is found by name only. The stored number is never changed by searching.
rules_global.whatsapp_links: WhatsApp links (decided 20 Nov 2026, build in chunk E after the report): the receipts rule (no wa.me web page that fails offline) applies to every WhatsApp action: reminders, the WhatsApp icon buttons, Remind on WhatsApp and Send receipt. They all use one shared function. With a phone number saved it opens that person’s chat with the text filled in through the installed app; without one it opens the phone’s share sheet. wa.me is only a fallback, never the first choice while offline. The 7-day reminder check and record are unchanged. Nothing is sent automatically. Details after the 4c report (21 Nov 2026): on a phone (Android, iPhone, iPad) a reminder or receipt with a valid saved number opens whatsapp://send?phone=233…&text=… directly, from a button that calls the shared function (not an <a href> to wa.me); wa.me is used only on desktop. A number that fails the Ghana check goes to the share sheet and is reported in the test list. Home reminders use the real shop name like the Owed list, 29/43 and Debt saved (Home currently says "StoreKeeper Light", a bug). Dead wa.me builders that only tests use are removed with their tests. Offline (decided 21 Nov 2026, from phone tests: the direct whatsapp://send?phone link and wa.me both fail offline with WhatsApp’s "No internet connection", while the phone’s share sheet works offline): when the phone is offline, every WhatsApp action (reminders, the WhatsApp icon buttons, Remind on WhatsApp, Debt saved, Send receipt) opens the phone’s share sheet with the text instead of the direct link, so the merchant picks the chat and WhatsApp keeps the message until the phone is back online. Online, a valid number still opens that person’s chat directly. If there is no share sheet, a small sheet offers "Copy reminder" (or "Copy receipt") and "Open WhatsApp anyway". The reminder is recorded as before.
rules_global.left_edge_marker: Not used (decided 24 Nov 2026). No card has a coloured left edge: not on Home, not on Today's transactions (24), not on My money (33). Kinds are told apart by label and a small neutral icon. Red and amber are kept only for Late tags, overdue wording and error boxes.
rules_global.soft_tiles: Soft tiles (decided 23 Nov 2026, mockup approved; one look for everything the owner only reads). Read-only blocks use the soft tile: fill #F1F5F9, no border, 16–20px radius. Applies to: the balance block on 29/43 and the wide Owed pane, the 'You owe' block on 73, the event cards in What happened on 29, 43 and 73, the person chip on 24, and the 'Total owed to you' card on 32. No pink or red fill anywhere on these. Amounts inside are neutral dark #0F172A (no dark red). Red stays only on the Late tag and on overdue wording. Inside a soft tile the row dividers are #E2E8F0 and tags (for example Not signed) are white. Things the owner presses keep a white fill and a border: person cards on 32 (Collect, WhatsApp, Call), buttons, filter chips, search. 'Spent money' keeps its wording (decided 23 Nov 2026). On a grey page background (the wide Owed list column) the 'Total owed to you' figure sits directly on the page with no tile, because a #F1F5F9 tile would vanish; the tile is used on white surfaces (phone pages and the wide detail pane). (decided 23 Nov 2026 after the live check.) Home hero (decided 24 Nov 2026, phone and wide): the Money left today block is a soft tile, not a dark green block: fill #F1F5F9, no border, 24px radius, label in #334155, the amount large (44px phone) in #0F172A, with white Money in and Spent chips inside and an eye button with a 2px #94A3B8 border on white. Sell is the only saturated block on Home. Phone sweep (decided 24 Nov 2026): every read-only block on the phone that still has a pink or mint fill (19 Owed and Paying today and Still owed row, 25 Owed block, 34 Owes from this sale, 43 and 54 balance blocks) uses the soft tile: #F1F5F9, no coloured border, neutral dark text. Pink and red stay only on Late tags, overdue wording and error boxes. Summary tiles (decided 24 Nov 2026, phone and wide): on Today's transactions (24) the Money in hero and the Spent and Given on credit tiles are all soft tiles (#F1F5F9, no border, no coloured edge, dark text); each has a small neutral dark-grey icon beside its label (arrow up for Money in, arrow down for Spent, card for Given on credit). The Owed to you and You owe suppliers buttons on My money (33) have no coloured left edge and neutral amounts; they stay white pressed buttons with a border. The Money left today hero on My money (33) is the same soft hero as Home. No coloured left edge is used anywhere. The small icon on the 24 summary tiles is hidden below 360px viewport width (display none) so labels such as Given on credit stay on one line at 340px; from 360px up it shows. Wide Home hero (decided 24 Nov 2026): a tile's fill is the opposite of the page behind it. On the white phone page the hero is the soft grey tile. On the grey wide page the hero is a white card with a 2px #CBD5E1 border and 20px radius, like the Owed and Today's transactions cards, with Money in and Spent as soft grey (#F1F5F9) chips inside. The hero card stretches to the full height of the Sell and Spent money column (equal height, 8px grid) with the chips at the bottom and at least 12px between the amount and the chips. In the Owed rows on Home the amount is vertically centred on the Collect, WhatsApp and phone buttons. The Collect first label and the Today's transactions card title use the same size and weight. Rail exception (24 Nov 2026): at 768 to 1279 the Home hero sits above Sell and Spent money (stacked, as in D6), so the equal-height rule applies only at 1280 and above.
rules_global.neutral_amounts: Amounts are neutral #0F172A everywhere (decided 24 Nov 2026), including Owes, Left to pay, Still owed, Spent, On credit, Given on credit, and supplier owed amounts. Green stays for money in and Paid. Red only for Late tags, overdue wording and error boxes. Amber only for notices. The Spent and On credit columns in Today's transactions are neutral too.
rules_global.leave_question: Leave question (decided 24 Nov 2026, phone and wide). One rule and one shared mechanism (useLeaveGuard with the one LeaveDraftDialog mounted in PosApp). A screen that holds typed values registers whether they differ from what was saved or from the start, with its own question. If they differ and the exit would drop them, every exit asks first: the on-screen Back, a device or browser Back, a tab, the header Home, Home in the Menu and the wide sidebar. Wording for forms: "Your changes to this {thing} are not saved. Leave without saving?" with Stay (the default, closes the question) and Leave. If nothing changed, the exit just happens with no question. A device Back while the question is open means Stay. The question is shown only when the draft would really be dropped: Back inside the sale-on-credit flow (15, 17, 34/18, 19, 27) keeps the draft and never asks, except the existing received-MoMo question. Screens that ask: wide Items (39, D8) and the phone Edit item and New item (40, 41), because their typed values live only on the screen and Back really drops them. Screens that do not: Stock on credit (45) and manual debt (53) (corrected 24 Nov 2026: their drafts are kept in the route and come back when the screen is reopened, so nothing is lost and the 12 Nov draft_survives_trip_away rule stays), Settings (47, 60, 63: the Shop name and MoMo drafts are kept in the route params), Spent money (44) and the credit flow. A dirty flag is cleared when the screen unmounts, so it can never trap the owner. Back at the root (Home) still leaves the app. Offline: no effect, all in memory.
